state.convention: Every caught error must be logged with the request ID before it is handled or re-thrown.

violates.instructions: Does the code break the stated convention?

fix.instructions: What change would bring the code in line with the convention?

criteria.add_logging: Log the error with the request ID
criteria.rethrow: Re-throw the error to the caller
criteria.none_needed: The code already follows the convention

severity.instructions: How much does the violation matter in production?
criteria: Hides failures from the people on call
